dedupe_keys.name: global supply routes wfp sdi t logistics database

description: Global supply routes (WFP SDI-T - Logistics Database) is a dataset listed in Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX), an open data portal, published or maintained by WFP - World Food Programme. Global supply routes for Transportation of Food and Non Food Items - Roads, Railways, Waterway, Airways. This layer is built by linking origin/destination locations using the most direct route on main roads. In reality, the supply routes can divert from the ones displayed here depending on many local factors. Coverage: not tied to one country in the listing. The portal files it under the publisher WFP - World Food Programme. Its tags are geodata, logistics, transportation. It offers 3 resource(s) in GEOJSON, SHP, TXT. The portal shows 2025-08-26 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution Share-Alike (CC BY-SA). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hdx-humanitarian-data-exchange.
